controls.label: View
controls.detail: Only shown when project has multiple views.

shape_list.name: Visible
shape_list.fact: Show or hide while retaining editability.

shape_list.name: Overlay color
shape_list.fact: Color of the outline in the Viewer.

shape_list.name: Motion blur
shape_list.fact: Whether shape motion blur is applied.

shape_list.name: View
shape_list.fact: Views where item appears; only for multi-view projects.
shape_list.cannot_match_reason: Stereo-only column; NodeBased has no multi-view project support.

shape_list.name: Lifetime
shape_list.fact: Frames during which item is visible.

shape_list.name: Source
shape_list.fact: Source selected in Shape, Stroke, or RotoPaint controls.

shape_list.name: Layers and folders
shape_list.fact: The list shows hierarchy; Add new layer creates a folder; drag/drop reorders and moves items among groups; groups can be transformed together; newest items sit on top.

viewer_editing.name: Add point
viewer_editing.fact: Adds points to an existing shape.

viewer_editing.name: Move point
viewer_editing.fact: Drag selected point(s) or point handles.

viewer_editing.name: Feather add
viewer_editing.fact: Increase feather or set individual feather vector.

viewer_editing.name: Feather drag
viewer_editing.fact: Adjust feather handle; feather is linked by default.

viewer_editing.name: Tangent create
viewer_editing.binding: LMB drag while placing Bezier point

viewer_editing.name: Tangent move both
viewer_editing.fact: Set the opposite handle to the same length.

viewer_editing.name: Transform box
viewer_editing.binding: T with Select tool; Shift+LMB points
viewer_editing.fact: Show jack/box or produce a transform box for selected points.

viewer_editing.name: Bezier/B-Spline handles/tension
viewer_editing.binding: Drag while placing; Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+drag point for B-Spline tension
viewer_editing.fact: The guide names the Ctrl/Cmd+Alt-drag gesture but does not specify how drag distance maps to tension.

viewer_editing.name: Sharp exit while drawing
viewer_editing.fact: Create a sharp exit on previous point.

viewer_editing.name: B-Spline tension
viewer_editing.fact: The guide names the Ctrl/Cmd+Alt-drag gesture but does not specify how drag distance maps to tension.

viewer_editing.name: Tool change
viewer_editing.fact: Changing tool closes a shape per procedure page.

viewer_editing.name: Escape to selection
viewer_editing.fact: Return to current Select tool outside shape drawing.

viewer_editing.name: Reveal onion skin
viewer_editing.fact: Toggle source as onion skin with transform jack.

timing_animation.name: Autokey
timing_animation.fact: Changes on subsequent frames create spline/attribute keys.

timing_animation.name: Set key: spline
timing_animation.fact: Quick access shows current/total keys, navigation and set/delete.

timing_animation.name: Delete key: spline
timing_animation.fact: The spline key control can set or delete spline keys.

timing_animation.name: Set/delete point keys
timing_animation.fact: Spline keys apply to points; individual keyed properties are edited in the control panel.

timing_animation.name: Set key: transform
timing_animation.fact: Per-field keyframe controls are listed in the RotoPaint transform panel.

timing_animation.name: Lifetime types
timing_animation.binding_or_values: All; start to frame; single frame; to end; range
timing_animation.fact: RotoPaint lifetime default is single frame; shape default is all frames.

timing_animation.name: Lifetime endpoints
timing_animation.fact: From applies to single/to-end/range; To applies to start-to/range.

timing_animation.name: Ripple editing
timing_animation.binding_or_values: Not stated in the traversed Nuke 17 guide pages
timing_animation.fact: No ripple timing operation is specified in the official RotoPaint chapter or reference pages.

timing_animation.name: Per-shape keyframe controls
timing_animation.fact: Shape/stroke keys can be scoped; key controls are available in the control panel.

timing_animation.name: Motion blur keys
timing_animation.binding_or_values: Motion blur samples, shutter, offset controls
timing_animation.fact: Per-shape motion-blur settings and shutter timing are listed in the Shape/Motion Blur panels.

reference_notes.group_default: Guide offers configurable startup tools but does not specify one fixed tool default per group.
reference_notes.list_order: Exact Nuke 17.0 list order comes from the official control reference table, page 212.
reference_notes.stereo_only: The View list column and clone source view control appear only for multi-view/stereoscopic projects.
reference_notes.ripple: Ripple editing is referenced in a third-party course description but is not described by the linked official Nuke 17 chapter/reference pages; not scored as a documented control.

reference_version_note: Facts use the Nuke 17.0 chapter help pages plus the official Nuke 17.0v3 Reference Guide page references for defaults, list columns and key controls. No guide prose is copied.
